title: Forecast ranges
bodyMd: A manufacturer used to publish a single forecast for next quarter’s demand. It now publishes a central estimate and a range based on several plausible input scenarios. A director complains that a range looks less confident. The planning team replies that a precise-looking number does not remove uncertainty; showing the range helps managers identify decisions that work across several outcomes. The range is not described as a guarantee that demand cannot fall outside it.
